text.p: - Shareholders of Compagnie Vaudoise d'Electricite and Societe Romande d'Electricite approved the merger of the companies, retroactive to January 1.
- Latests statistics show that more than 300,000 people in Switzerland are addicted to alcohol and some one million to tobacco.
- Swiss Foreign Minister Flavio Cotti is cutting some benefits of Swiss diplomats abroad by 12 percent despite protests. - Cablecom wants to keep Telecom PTT as its majority shareholder.
- Daily newspaper Journal de Geneve and the Nouveau Quotidien are merging and will be called the Nouveau Journal. -- Zurich Editorial +41 1 631 7340
